meta.title: RFQ: raise by 10 (100 → 110)
gaps: Starting from an RFQ with exactly two bids, including Vendor A at 100 and Vendor B at 90; the prepared state contains only one bid.
Checking the company setting that allows or blocks RFQ price increases, or conditionally asserting the refusal message "You cannot increase the price".
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Starting from an RFQ with exactly two bids, including Vendor A at 100 and Vendor B at 90; the prepared state contains only one bid.; Checking the company setting that allows or blocks RFQ price increases, or conditionally asserting the refusal message "You cannot increase the price".

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ event without creating or searching for another event.
Move to the invited vendor's separate supplier-portal session while preserving the buyer session.
Open the prepared RFQ's pricing round and its existing bid sheet.
Submit 110 as the same vendor's revised bid, replacing the existing 100 bid.
Assert that the vendor portal accepted the revised submission.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Open the buyer's Responses view for the revised RFQ.
Assert that the buyer sees the vendor response after revision.
Open the buyer's Master QCS comparison grid.
Assert that the buyer's comparison grid shows the revised RFQ rate as 110.
